_help: Edit this file to change what the site pulls in automatically. The scanner (tools/update-feed.mjs) runs every 30 minutes on GitHub Actions, or by hand with: node tools/update-feed.mjs --force

yourChannel.name: SX Exclusive
yourChannel._onlyIfTitleHas: Only videos whose title contains one of these (whole words, any case) appear on SX TV. Older SX music videos stay on YouTube, they just are not shown here. Put GTA 6 or #GTA6 in every GTA upload title.

news.query: "GTA 6" OR "GTA VI" OR "Grand Theft Auto VI"
news._skip: skipSources: publishers checked and found unreliable (see content/intel.json rejected). skipIfTitleHas: shopping posts, not news (whole words, any case).

intel._help: Research sources. kind official = Rockstar's own pages (shown as Official). outlet = a gaming outlet's own RSS (Reported). search = Google News topic searches (Reported when the publisher is in trustedPublishers, otherwise Unverified). community = discovery leads only (always Unverified).

sources.name: Search: patches
sources.q: "GTA 6" (patch OR update OR "patch notes" OR hotfix) when:7d

sources.name: Search: glitches
sources.q: "GTA 6" (glitch OR bug OR exploit OR softlock) when:7d

sources.name: Search: secrets
sources.q: "GTA 6" (secret OR "easter egg" OR hidden OR tips) when:7d

sources.name: r/GTA6
sources._why: Reddit put its RSS behind a login (checked 2026-11-25). Needs a Reddit API app (OAuth) to turn back on; never scrape around it.

publish._help: Scans run every 30 minutes, but each Netlify production deploy can cost credits. New findings are published at most every everyMinutes; a new Official Rockstar item publishes on the next scan. heartbeatHours republishes unchanged findings so last-checked times stay honest.
